question.text: The formula for long futures payoff at expiry is:

answer.text: ST - F, where ST is spot price at expiry and F is the futures entry price

explanation.text: The Logic: Long futures payoff = ST - F. If the spot price at expiry exceeds the futures entry price, the long position gains; if it is lower, the long position loses. The Trap: F - ST is the short futures payoff. ST × F and (ST + F)/2 are not valid payoff formulas. Note: The futures payoff is linear and changes symmetrically with the underlying price — equal moves in spot translate into equal-sized P&L for long and short positions.
